title: Host-declared navigation groups and pages
summary: Hosts supply ordered navigation groups and unscoped pages through UniverseAppOptions.navigation; the host owns access and content. Stable base-path routes carry optional detail and preserve host-owned query strings and fragments on open and reload. Content signals abort on navigation or unmount. Optional page icon keys select built-in navigation SVGs; unknown keys leave a blank slot. Optional collapsible groups start closed and remember state by group id (up to 64 characters), sharing state with built-in groups when ids match.
